avis.titre: As a facial scrub used 2 times a week, this scrub helps to clean pores and remove dead skin cellsAs a facial scrub used
avis.texte: I am 71 years old, and have been using this face scrub/mask for about two weeks. First of all, I don't have any major skin problems. I have been using all natural products on my face for the last couple of years, and noticed a couple of what looks like blackheads at the side of my nose. Whether this was caused by the oils I use on my face or just an aging thing, I don't know. At any rate, I decided it was time to look for a facial scrub, and chose this one because of the natural ingredients. As a facial scrub, I love it. The granules are small and not like rocks and the substance they are in applies easily and fluidly. The directions on the container recommend applying and leaving on your face for 1-3 minutes. Since I don't have a lot of spare time and am always in a hurry, I have managed to leave it on for 1 minute and have used it 3 times per week. I have noticed that the little blackheads around my nose are disappearing, it rinses off easily, and my face feels so much cleaner feeling than it has with other cleansers I have tried. I do use rose water and a natural moisturizer afterwards, and have to say that my skin looks brighter and healthier. I have not yet tried this product as a facial mask that would require leaving it on for 15-20 minutes, but I will try this in the near future. If this works as a mask, it would be so much better than the thick grey stuff you need to smear on your face and let it dry until it cracks. At this point, I am very happy with the results wh

avis.titre: Helping with my Keratosis Pilaris Rubra Faceii
avis.texte: So far I love this product! I have been using this in conjunction with some other Era Organic products, and have to say, I am pleased with the results so far. To give you a background on my skin, I have Keratosis Pilaris Rubra Faceii. If you are unfamiliar with it, it is where your skin is rough, and bumpy due to hair follicles getting plugged up with keratin, along with redness and flushing on the face. I have tried various products over the years. My recent skincare regime was using an exfoliating cleanser with AHA/BHA (acids). However, my face was feeling very dried out, especially now that it is the winter. My skin has days where it looks much worse, and flairs up so it looks very red. Usually if I can combat the bumps, it helps combat the redness. I started using the Era Organics Cleanser & Relief for my skin. I especially like that it contains manuka honey, since I have been prone to break out in the past as well. Although I was feeling like my skin was getting the nutrients it needs, I felt like it needed a little more. So, I decided to try the microdermabrasion scrub. I love it!! After reading other reviews I was worried it wouldn't give me the exfoliation I needed... but it does. I actually use this once a day, if possible, since I do have such rough skin. Here is the new regimen I have created! - Cleanse first with Era Organics cleanser (I don't use a wash cloth, but I do use a plain Konjac sponge to help aid in a little exfoliation) - Use the microdermabrasion scru

avis.titre: Leaves my skin soft and vibrant!
avis.texte: I've been using this product for a couple of weeks now, and I prefer this much more over just chemical exfoliants. It immediately leaves my skin looking bright, vibrant, hydrated, and soft. It gets rid of dull textures and reduces blackheads as well. This will be a common part of my routine now, as I have seen great results with just a couple of uses! Don't be fooled by the small bottle, sure when you first get it you'll think "this is really small, it's not worth my money" but you don't actually need a lot of product to get the full coverage or benefits. Plus, I only use this when my skin is looking dull from all the dead skincell buildup, which is once every other couple of weeks. So if you're using this 2-3 times a week I feel you may go through the product very quickly. What I liked: - The mixture is light and creamy and goes on well. - The walnut granules are soft enough on your skin that they're not abrasive. After exfoliation it leaves my skin feeling soft, and my dull skin looks bright and vibrant! It has also helped to regulate my blackheads. - It is surprisingly hydrating when it glides on your skin. Because of the aloe, honey, and rapeseed oil it feels like a film/ mask that's keeping the moisture in on your skin in. What I didn't like: - The product is not sealed beneath the cap. Once you open it, the product is visible, which makes it seem like someone may have used it and returned it. It would feel more hygenic if there was a breakable seal, that way we know the

avis.titre: Great exfoliation. Some concerns.Great exfoliation. Some concerns.
avis.texte: Great exfoliation, but I have some product concerns. I used this exfoliator and I enjoyed the experience. It left my face soft and squeaky clean. The scent is heavy on the walnut, and I like earthy smells! My concerns: Packaging. I'm not impressed with the plastic. The look of the product in the packaging concerned me enough to scoop out the product and weigh it (It came out to 1.9oz). For the price, I'd expect packaging to not be a concern. EWG rating. This product is a 3 on the EWG scale, with emulsifying wax being a high concern. I would love if this product could get EWG certified!

A lot of the other scrubs that I’ve purchased do not have the coarseness to really exfoliate like this one does. It doesn’t have a sense so if this is important to you, you may want to find another product. Personally, I like that it does not have a scent. The price and the product are great!

I've only used this once so far but I could tell the difference right away from other exfoliating products. Most are really bad for my skin, being fairly sensitive with mild rosacea, but this one didn't leave my face all red and irritated. I used it as a face mask, and when I washed it off it felt like it was moisturizing my face instead of drying it out. The walnut that acts as an exfoliator is gentle and doesn't make you feel like you're scrubbing your skin away trying to wash the mask off. The one down side I can find for the product (other than a fragrant, natural odor that I can deal with) is the price for a small container. But that's how it is getting organic products most of the time unfortunately. I would say it is worth it. You probably will only feel the need to use this once a week, so for one person it could last a while. We'll see how it works over the next few tries, but I think I will be buying again. Thank you EraOrganics!

avis.titre: Sweet Results Without the Sticky Mess
avis.texte: This Manuka Honey Exfoliating Face Scrub is basically a spa day in a jar minus the robe and cucumber water. It exfoliates just enough to make my skin feel baby-smooth without feeling like I rubbed my face with sandpaper. The honey leaves my skin glowing, soft, and happily hydrated, not tight or dry. Bonus points for smelling amazing and making my face feel like it finally has its life together. If you want smooth, radiant skin and a little “treat yourself” moment at the sink, this scrub is it. Five stars my face is obsessed 🍯✨

OMG! I love this stuff! Being a wound care nurse, I am very aware of the benefits of manuka honey and collagen and I needed a good face scrub to take away the dullness and flaky skin from my face. I also have issues with breakouts sometimes and the manuka honey mixed with the exfoliating granules help slough away the dead skin cells, dirt, oil, and bacteria so my pores stay squeaky clean! There’s not much of a smell but I’m okay with that because smell means usually means perfumes and since my skin is so sensitive and becomes inflamed very easily I appreciate the absence of scent irritants. I have already recommended this too many friends (heck I shouted off the rooftops of Facebook! lol) and they have liked the product as well. Definitely Worth the money to have fresh and clean skin. I included a pic of my skin since I started using the product. No filter…just squeaky clean and silky smooth! Happy shopping, friends!

avis.titre: Excellent ingredients and ease of use. Good job!
avis.texte: This product has excellent ingredients. I put a small amount on my face (while in the shower) after wetting my face with warm water. I leave it on as the bath gets steamy. After showering, I gently massage in circular motions. Then rinse with warm water. At the end, rinse in cold water. Looks great!

I have always been a fan of St Ives however this scrub is leaps and bounds better than the apricot scrub I used to use. I like to place it all over my skin when I first get in the shower after cleaning. I scrub with my finger tips and then leave on my face while I wash and condition my hair. I feel that it almost serves as a face mask, hydrating and brightening and maybe even firming my mature skin while I bathe. It’s great! 10/10 recommend!
